# Integration Surfaces Requirements Checklist: Obsidian Link Resolver CLI

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the interoperability surfaces — CLI machine-mode protocol, versioned JSON schema data contract, C-compatible ABI/FFI boundary, determinism, exit statuses, and release artifacts (are these requirements complete, clear, consistent, and measurable?)
**Created**: 2026-09-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the required fields of the machine-mode result record enumerated completely for each outcome status? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK002 Is the versioned JSON schema contract's versioning and backward-compatibility policy documented? [Gap, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK003 Are the C-compatible ABI/FFI function surface, memory-ownership rules, and error-reporting semantics specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for the vault-index reuse lifecycle across consecutive FFI calls (initialize, reuse, dispose)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021a]
- [x] CHK005 Are exit statuses enumerated and mapped to every outcome (success, unresolved, sub-target-not-found, ambiguous, error)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, §SC-002]
- [x] CHK006 Are release-artifact requirements complete for all platforms/architectures (Linux x64+arm64, macOS x64+arm64, Windows x64) for BOTH the CLI and the shared library? [Completeness, Spec §SC-008]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "compact, deterministic machine-readable output" defined with a concrete format and record structure? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK008 Are "stable field names" anchored to the versioned schema rather than left implicit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK009 Is the stdout-versus-stderr separation unambiguous for all outcomes, including error conditions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018] — NOTE: core stdout=results / stderr=diagnostics split is clear (FR-018, cli.md); consider stating explicitly whether usage/argument errors (exit 1) also emit a `{"status":"error"}` record on stdout.
- [x] CHK010 Is byte-for-byte determinism scoped by explicitly identifying which fields are excluded (e.g., timestamps)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK011 Is a "warm run" defined distinctly from a cold run for the purpose of the latency gate? [Gap, Spec §SC-005] — FINDING [open]: "warm run" is used consistently (SC-005, plan.md, research.md, quickstart.md) but never explicitly defined (e.g., criterion steady-state after warmup vs OS-cache-warm vs FFI session reuse); define it so the blocking gate is unambiguous.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK012 Do the JSON schema contract and the FFI result representation expose the same fields and semantics? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK013 Are exit-status definitions consistent with the outcome set in FR-010 and the criteria in SC-002? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK014 Is the determinism requirement stated consistently across the CLI and FFI surfaces? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, §FR-021]
- [x] CHK015 Are the integration surfaces (CLI protocol, JSON schema, FFI/ABI) described consistently between FR-021 and the success criteria SC-006/SC-007? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, §SC-006, §SC-007]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Is the ≤100 ms budget's measurement method fully specified (p50, warm run, ~5,000-note representative vault) as a testable gate? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK017 Is the release test-gate ordering (full suite passes → artifacts produced) specified unambiguously? [Clarity, Spec §SC-008]
- [x] CHK018 Can "many consecutive resolutions without a per-call process spawn" be objectively measured or verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007, §FR-021a]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK019 Is the "no hard dependencies precluding .NET/Node.js integration" constraint expressed with concrete, checkable criteria? [Assumption, Spec §FR-021b]
- [x] CHK020 Are the UTF-8 encoding and single-link-per-invocation assumptions reflected in the integration/data contract? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Edge Case & Exception Coverage

- [x] CHK021 Are error-record requirements defined for the FFI boundary (how errors surface across the ABI without exceptions)? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK022 Are backward-compatibility/stability requirements defined for exit codes and schema fields across releases? [Gap, Spec §FR-017, §FR-021]

## Notes
